_comment: S1 collision proxies, millimetres. head/jaw: type 'hull' = a collision geom using the print mesh itself, which MuJoCo collides as its convex hull (tight on the outside of the shells; the bodies carry explicit inertia, so nothing changes in the dynamics); type box/ellipsoid: head-mesh axes (x width, -y front, z up), centre relative to the named mesh's origin. The torso proxies are the outer blocks of design/v4/v4_params.json (bevels ignored, so slightly conservative), named body_<block>_collision; scripts/make_duck.py derives them from there. Verify with scripts/check_collision_proxies.py.

_old_primitives_2026_11_25._note: replaced by convex-hull mesh geoms of the shells (collision_proxy_check: the jaw box left 23 % of the jaw outside, the lower-head box reached up to 22 mm past the shell and failed the head/body contact gate); kept for reference only, not used
